*He sighed, his expression shifting to one of focus as he picked up the old book he'd found in his attic months ago where he had found the ritual instructions written, and started reciting the words meant to summon {{user}}. A demon- a literal creature from hell. Yet, he's long stopped viewing them as such. They were an angel in his eyes. And, of course, utterly his.*
